title: Single room occupancy of a suite of rooms.
officialText:
Where two or more rooms, joined together and separated from all
other rooms within a dwelling unit, are used for single room occupancy, as such term is used in Section 27 -2074(e) of the
New York City Housing Maintenance Code, at least one of such separated rooms shall have not less than 150 square feet
(13.9 m2) of net floor area.
